title: Design prototypes on GitHub Pages
lede: The Pages deploy now publishes `docs/prototypes/` at `prototypes/`, with an index like the walkthroughs. `site.js` builds both sites through one shared list page.

files.question: When do prototypes reach the site?
files.summary: The site step now gets `dist` and writes both folders, still only on pushes to `main`.
files.owns: Running the site step before the Pages upload.
files.tested: Not run in CI yet: the step runs only on a push to `main`. The same command was run locally.

files.question: Which pages ship, and how is each list made?
files.summary: `buildWalkthroughs` and `buildPrototypes` copy their pages and write an index through the shared `indexPage`.
files.owns: Choosing pages, titles and order for each folder, and escaping.
files.never: Builds or checks walkthroughs, or edits a prototype.
files.tested: `site.test.js`: walkthrough order, escaping and the template left out; prototype order, `<title>` with its fallback, and `README.md` left out.

steps.title: push to main: the site step gets the whole site folder
steps.explain: The argument changed from `dist/walkthroughs` to `dist`, because the script now writes two folders. Not run in CI yet: the first push to `main` after this merge proves it.

run.from: - name: Add walkthroughs and prototypes to the site

steps.title: the script builds both folders
steps.explain: `docs` is found from the script's own location, so it doesn't matter which folder CI runs it from. Run locally on `main`'s files, it wrote 9 walkthroughs and 7 prototypes.

steps.title: prototypes are copied and listed
steps.explain: Every `.html` file ships, so `README.md` stays out. Prototypes have no spec, so each title comes from its page's `<title>`, falling back to the file name. They are listed alphabetically, because they have no issue numbers to sort by.

steps.title: walkthroughs are built as before
steps.explain: The order and titles are the same as before. The issue tag moved out of the list page into a `tag`, so `indexPage` no longer knows what a walkthrough is.

notes.title: Titles from `<title>`, not from the README table
notes.detail: The prototypes README has a better one-line question for each page, but parsing a Markdown table is fragile. The counter-argument is that the index has less context than the README.

notes.title: The script stays in `docs/walkthroughs/`
notes.detail: It now serves prototypes too. Moving it would touch CI, the tests and the docs for no change in behaviour.

omitted.docs/walkthroughs/site.test.js: Tests for `site.js`, described in its `tested` field.
omitted.docs/prototypes/README.md: One line naming the published URL.
